shortDescription: Manage vCenter on a PowerStore storage system

options.name: address
options.description: IP address of vCenter, in IPv4, IPv6, hostname format. Mandatory while adding a vCenter. To modify the address, a new address of the same vCenter must be passed.

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: delete_vasa_provider
options.description: Whether to remove VASA provider. When C(true), remove the VASA provider from vCenter. This will only happen if provider is not connected to any other PowerStore system. C(false) is the API default.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the vCenter instance after the task is performed. For get, create, and modify operations it should be set to C(present).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: update_password
options.description: This parameter controls the way the I(vcenter_password) is updated during addition and modification of the vCenter. C(always) will update password for each execution. C(on_create) will only set while adding a vCenter or modifying the I(vcenter_username.) For modifying I(vcenter_password), set the I(update_password) to C(always).

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: vasa_provider_credentials
options.description: Credentials required for registering VASA vendor provider.

options.name: vcenter_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the vCenter instance.

options.name: vcenter_password
options.description: Password to login to vcenter. Mandatory while adding a vCenter.

options.name: vcenter_username
options.description: User name to login to vcenter. Mandatory while adding a vCenter. I(vcenter_password) needs to be provided to modify the user name.
